body:
### Summary

When running a `uv add` command to update an optional dependency, the position of an inline comment is shifted to a different line.  This particular optional dependency is at the end of a category of optional dependencies and lacks a trailing comma before the inline comment.

### Minimum reproducible example

I start from the following `pyproject.toml`:

```toml
[project]
name = "grumblemuffins"
license = "BSD-3-Clause"
license-files = ["LICENSE.rst", "licenses/*.rst"]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = [ ]
dynamic = [ "version" ]

[project.optional-dependencies]
typing = [
    "pandas-stubs>=2.0.2",
    "narwhals>=1.42.0" # narwhals are toothed whales native to the Arctic
]

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"
```

I run the command:
```bash
uv add --optional=typing 'narwhals>=1.42'
```

The section is changed to
```toml
[project.optional-dependencies]
typing = [
    "pandas-stubs>=2.0.2", # narwhals are toothed whales native to the Arctic
    "narwhals>=1.42",
]
```

The inline comment is shifted to the line above. I originally found this for Astropy's `pyproject.toml`.

### Workaround

Adding a trailing comma prevents the comment from being shifted to a different line.  Use trailing commas, everyone! 🎂🎆🪩🌌🥦😅

### Platform

Linux 5.14.0-687.24.1.el9_8.x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.2 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

_No response_
title: Location of inline comment not preserved when using `uv add` for an optional dependency
